story_overview: In a shadowed Gothic hall, Marek and Kai violently tumble down a staircase while Viktor smirks from above and Annelise confronts the fallen. The conflict expands as Elias, Sonia, and Annelise flee through a tunnel, and Lucian is found in agony. The narrative culminates in a ruined chamber where survivors look down upon the defeated Kai and Viktor.

video_prompts:
Marek: Man with long dark hair, a prominent cheek scar, wearing a dark long coat and a tooth necklace.
Viktor: Man wearing a dark, fur-collared coat.
Annelise: Woman with blonde hair wearing a dark top and a light-colored fur stole.
The Shadowed Hall: Dark, cavernous, and dusty Gothic castle hall with stone construction and a high interior stone balcony.

Inside The Shadowed Hall, Marek descends a large stone staircase, glaring down at Viktor who stands at the bottom. From the high interior stone balcony above, Annelise watches them both, a faint smirk on her face.
action_descriptions: Inside The Shadowed Hall, Marek descends a large stone staircase, glaring down at Viktor who stands at the bottom. From the high interior stone balcony above, Annelise watches them both, a faint smirk on her face.

video_prompts:
Lucian: Man with sharp vampire fangs.
The Spotlight Chamber: A nondescript, dark interior space containing a single spotlight fixture.
High-angle close-up in The Spotlight Chamber. Lucian lies on his back on the floor, his face contorted in agony as he screams, baring the vampire fangs at an unseen figure looming over him.
action_descriptions: High-angle close-up in The Spotlight Chamber. Lucian lies on his back on the floor, his face contorted in agony as he screams, baring the vampire fangs at an unseen figure looming over him.

video_prompts:
Elias: Man with long white hair, wearing a white hooded outfit.
the black katana: Japanese katana with a black cord-wrapped hilt over white rayskin, a solid circular black iron handguard, and a matching pommel cap, housed within a matte black lacquered sheath.

Medium close-up in The Shadowed Hall. Elias watches a chaotic battle intently, his head turning slightly to track the blurry figures fighting in the background. The black katana is sheathed on his back.
action_descriptions: Medium close-up in The Shadowed Hall. Elias watches a chaotic battle intently, his head turning slightly to track the blurry figures fighting in the background. The black katana is sheathed on his back.

The Hazy Void: A dark, undefined room with a thick, hazy, smoke-filled atmosphere.
the arched window: Tall arched window.
Kai: Figure of indeterminate gender and age with short, spiky hair, wearing a long, tattered dark coat
Inside The Hazy Void, Kai walks into a beam of light from the arched window, their body cast in silhouette.

video_prompts:
Sonia: Woman wearing a dark shirt.
The Ironstone Tunnel: A narrow, arched underground tunnel constructed from rough, damp-streaked stone blocks, with an uneven packed earth floor and rusted metal conduits affixed to the walls.

Low-angle medium close-up in The Ironstone Tunnel. Elias runs, the black katana sheathed on his back, followed closely by Sonia and Annelise. Elias abruptly stops and looks upward with a startled, alert expression.
action_descriptions: Low-angle medium close-up in The Ironstone Tunnel. Elias runs, the black katana sheathed on his back, followed closely by Sonia and Annelise. Elias abruptly stops and looks upward with a startled, alert expression.

video_prompts:
Rowan: Person with long dark hair and a gash on their forehead.

Low-angle shot in The Hazy Void. Dramatically backlit by bright light from the arched window, Annelise walks slowly forward from silhouette into the light, her serious facial expression becoming clear through the smoke. Rowan stands in the hazy background, subtly shifting their weight.
action_descriptions: Low-angle shot in The Hazy Void. Rowan stands in the hazy background, subtly shifting their weight.

video_prompts: Elias looks upward toward Rowan, his eyes widening in shock as his mouth falls slightly open. His striking, glowing light blue eyes intensify, illuminating his face from the shadows.
